We'll have you flying in no time.|Drawd Munbrin, to Han Solo|}} '''Drawd Munbrin''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Imperial Recruitment Officer|recruitment officer]] who held the [[military rank]] of [[Navy|naval]] [[captain]] and [[chief]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]. By [[13 BBY]], Munbrin was stationed in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]], where he encountered the future [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo|Han]]. Munbrin gave Han the surname Solo. ==Biography== ===Encounter with Han=== {{Quote|What's your name, son?''"
"''Han.''"
"''Han what? Who are your people?''"
"''I don't have people. I'm alone.''"
"''Han… Solo.|Drawd Munbrin and Han "Solo"|}} [[File:MunbrinSoloName-Solo.png|thumb|left|250px|Munbrin enlists Han to the Carida Academy]] Drawd Munbrin''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' was a [[Navy|naval]] [[captain]] who served as a [[chief]] [[Imperial Recruitment Officer|recruitment officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]. [[Gender|His]] work consisted of enrolling recruits who desired to join the [[Imperial Military|Imperial Armed Forces]] into the [[Imperial Academy|Imperial Academies]]. In [[13 BBY]], Munbrin was stationed in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] enrolling the potential recruits for the Empire. One [[Standard day|day]], a young man named [[Han Solo|Han]] appeared and was interested in joining the Empire and becoming the best [[pilot]] in [[the galaxy]]. When Munbrin asked Han his surname, Han stated that he did not have one and indicated to the [[officer]] that he was alone. Munbrin decided to assign Han the surname "Solo" and sent him on his way to the [[Carida Academy|academy]] on [[Carida]]. ===Legacy=== The story of how Munbrin gave Solo his surname was made known. A [[Snivvian]] [[bounty hunter]], however, believed the story of Munbrin's encounter with Solo to be deliberate disinformation and believed instead that Solo was a direct descendant of the [[Prince-Admiral]] [[Jonashe Solo]], a member of the ancient [[Corellian royalty]]. A [[Crimson Dawn]] enforcer, on the other hand, believed that Solo was the grandson of the [[Corellian]] [[pirate]] [[Dalla Suul]] and that Munbrin misheard his surname when recruiting him.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]'' At some point, Han's son [[Ben Solo]] discovered how his father acquired his surname. However, while speaking with [[Snoke]] after the [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|destruction]] of [[Luke Skywalker]]'s [[Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker|Jedi temple]], Ben stated that he disliked his surname and that his [[Parent|father]] was a lie.[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 2|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 2]] ==Behind the scenes== Drawd Munbrin first appeared on the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', played by [[Andrew Woodall]]. In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], "[[Solo family/Legends|Solo]]" was not a nickname but the real surname of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]].''[[The Paradise Snare]]'' Munbrin's line when he gives Han his surname was the first line written for the film's script back in [[2012]] when [[Lawrence Kasdan]] pitched the film to Disney CEO [[Bob Iger (chief executive officer)|Bob Iger]] some weeks before [[The Walt Disney Company]] acquired [[Lucasfilm]] While he was talking with [[Simon Kinberg]] and [[Michael Arndt]], Kasdan told the pair about the moment when Han gets his name and how it happens.{{WebCite|url=https://www.syfy.com/syfywire/the-most-important-line-in-solo-a-star-wars-story-was-the-first-one-written|text=THE MOST IMPORTANT LINE IN SOLO: A STAR WARS STORY WAS THE FIRST ONE WRITTEN|author=Zakarin, Jordan|date=2018-05-15|work=[[Wikipedia:Syfy|Syfy Wire]]|archivedate=20190525031722}} Going by the Imperial rank chart created by [[Dave Crossman]] for use in both ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' and ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', Munbrin would be a [[captain]] of the [[Imperial Navy]].{{Instagram|username=glyn__dillon|url=p/BcDdpV7BNP1|name=[[Glyn Dillon]]|date=November 28, 2017|quote=I sometimes get asked, on Twitter, about certain things to do with the details of Star Wars costumes, especially Imperial costumes. I try to answer as best I can but I can't always remember... 'ranking' is something that crops up every now and then ...so I've been meaning to post this on here for a while. My co-designer, David Crossman is a military expert, much like John Mollo was, so this is something he put together, after studying all the OT films and working out what he thought John Mollo was doing with the Imperial ranking. It was devised for Rogue One... and if there are any Imperials in Solo, we would've have used this system again... But obviously I can't say if we did 😜 I hope it's useful for all the cosplayers and costumers out there|archiveurl=https://m.imgur.com/C05Pmj5}} ==Appearances== *[[Han Solo - Imperial Cadet 1|''Han Solo - Imperial Cadet'' 1]] *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 1|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 1]] ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|9Szts88zY4o|Solo: A Star Wars Story "Big Game" TV Spot (:45)|sw_url=video/big-game-tv-spot-solo-a-star-wars-story}} {{1stp}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' {{1stID|Drawd Munbrin}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]'' {{Imo}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Han Solo}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' {{Po}} *{{InsiderCite|209|Launchpad}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Drawd Munbrin |fr=Drawd Munbrin |ja=ドロード・マンブリン |ka=დროუდ მუნბრინი |pl=Drawd Munbrin |uk=Драуд Мунбрін }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Munbrin, Drawd}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Officers of the Galactic Empire]]
